name: motion-video
description: Short motion-design MP4 rendered offline with Pillow/numpy + ffmpeg (approach of the Farm presentation job)
goal: Create a premium {seconds}-second motion-design video titled '{title}' presenting these lines: {lines}. End card tagline: '{tagline}'.
constraints: Start from ./motion_reference.py (copied into this directory): adapt its LINES/title/end card/timing; keep the offline Pillow+numpy frame renderer piped to ffmpeg. Run it with the render venv python given in FARM_RENDER_PY or ../../tools/render-venv/bin/python. 1920x1080, 30 fps, h264, yuv420p, exactly {seconds}.0 s. Check every text line fits. Save 3 preview PNG frames in preview/. No network.
done_when: video.mp4 exists and ffprobe shows h264, yuv420p, 1920x1080, 30 fps, {seconds}.0 s; render.py and preview/*.png exist; all lines readable.
